Who is associated with the WORKSPACE, with the workspace role — the role every project inherits unless a project row overrides it. Completes `GET projects/:projectId/members`, which lists only project rows: whoever reaches a project through the workspace alone shows up here and not there. Only id, name, e-mail and role.
